THIS MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS APPEAL HAVING COME UP FOR HEARING ON 07.10.2025, THE COURT ON THE SAME DAY DELIVERED THE FOLLOWING:
 M.A.C.A.No.1053 of 2020  3  2025:KER:74086  C.S.SUDHA, J.

 M.A.C.A.No.1053 of 2020  -----------------------------------------------------------
 Dated this the 07th day of October 2025  JUDGMENT

This appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (the Act) has been filed by the claim petitioner in O.P.(MV) No.506 of 2017 on the file of the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal,
Kasaragod, (the Tribunal), aggrieved by the amount of compensation granted by Award dated 15/01/2020.
The respondents herein are the respondents in the petition.
In this appeal, the parties and the documents will be referred to as described in the original petition.

2. According to the claim petitioner, on 24/08/2016 at about 09:10 a.m., while he was riding scooter bearing registration No.KL-14S-6449 through NH road and when he reached the place by name Kopra Bazar, car bearing registration No.KL-58-B-9873 driven by the first respondent in a rash and negligent manner, knocked him down, as a result of which he sustained grievous injuries.
The first respondent/driver and the second respondent/owner remained ex parte.
4. The third respondent/insurer filed written statement admitting the policy but denying negligence on the part of the first respondent/driver of the offending car.
It was also contended that the amount claimed was excessive.
5. Before the Tribunal, no oral evidence was adduced by either side.
Exts. A1
to A6 and X1 were marked on the side of the claim petitioner.
No documentary evidence was produced by the respondents.

Muhammed Nazeem.B vs Mohammed Sikander Murshid K.M on 7 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/84898317/

sentences.text: The Tribunal on consideration of the documentary evidence and after hearing both sides, found negligence on the part of the first respondent/driver of the offending car resulting in the incident and hence awarded an amount of 1,76,431/- together with interest @ 9% per annum from the date of petition till realisation along with proportionate costs.
Aggrieved by the Award, the claim petitioner has come up in appeal.
7. The only point that arises for consideration in this 2025:KER:74086 appeal is whether there is any infirmity in the findings of the Tribunal calling for an interference by this Court.
8. Heard both sides.
9. The award of compensation by the Tribunal under the following heads is challenged by the claim petitioner- Notional income
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the claim petitioner that the latter, a businessman, was earning 10,000/- per month.

However, the Tribunal fixed the notional income at 8,000/- which is on the lower side going by the dictum in Ramachandrappa v. Manager,
Royal Sundaram Alliance Co. Ltd, (2011) 13 SCC 236.

entities.text:
Ramachandrappa v. Manager,
Royal Sundaram Alliance Co. Ltd, (2011) 13 SCC 236
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Per contra, it is submitted by the learned counsel for the third respondent/insurer that the amount that is fixed by the Tribunal is reasonable and no further enhancement is called for.
9.1.
Going by the dictum in Ramachandrappa (Supra), the income of a coolie in the year 2016 is liable to be fixed as 10,500/-.
The claim petitioner is stated to be a businessman.

Hence, in the facts and circumstances of the case, though only an amount of 2025:KER:74086 10,000/- is claimed in the petition, an amount of 10,500/- is fixed as the notional income of the claim petitioner.
Loss of earnings 10.

The materials on record show that the claim petitioner sustained the following injuries:
"fracture to left shaft femur proximal 1/3rd "
He was hospitalized for a period of 8 days.
In all probability, he might have been unable to work for a period of 5 months.
Hence, he can be awarded compensation for loss of earnings for a period of 5 months, that is, 10,500x 5 months=52,500/-.
Attender expenses 11.
The accident took place on 24/08/2016.
Hence, compensation at the rate of 450/- per day for a period of 8 days can be granted, that is, 450/-x8 days=3,600/-.
Compensation for pain and sufferings 12.
An amount of 2,00,000/- was claimed.
The Tribunal awarded an amount of 30,000/-.
In the facts and circumstances of the case, an amount of 50,000/- under this head 2025:KER:74086 would be just and reasonable.

13. The impugned Award is modified to the following extent :
